name: CES Helm Simulator
description: A high-fidelity maritime simulation developed for Brunswick Corporation to showcase autonomous boating intelligence at CES 2026.
contributions: Architected the physics-based boat swaying mechanics and integrated real-world sensor data into the Unreal Engine environment.
challenges: Synchronizing low-latency sensor telemetry with high-refresh-rate visual assets without jitter.
impact: Successfully demonstrated to 5,000+ attendees, resulting in a 40% increase in B2B engagement for autonomous systems.

images.caption: Testing the physics engine synchronization with hardware-in-the-loop telemetry rig.
Initial sketch of the LiDAR sensor mounting bracket for the autonomous boat hull.
Brunswick Corporation's 2026 CES floor layout showcasing the interactive simulation pod.

name: Echoes of the Elements
description: A third-person action-adventure game featuring Kael the vole, focused on elemental puzzles and fluid movement.
contributions: Designed the core movement system and the 'Earth' element ability set using a hybrid C++/Blueprint approach.
challenges: Optimizing mesh calculations for elemental destruction without dropping below 60fps.
impact: Achieved a stable 60fps on mid-range hardware while maintaining high-fidelity physics interactions.

images.caption: High-poly character sculpt for Kael, optimized for Unreal Engine 5's Nanite system.
Visual scripting logic for the Earth-bending ability interaction system.

name: CAD Simplifier
description: An automated desktop tool for optimizing high-poly CAD models for real-time applications.
contributions: Built the Python-based Blender bridge and the C++ UI framework for the desktop app.
challenges: Handling non-manifold geometry during the automated decimation process.
impact: Reduced average model polygon count by 85% while preserving critical visual silhouettes for AR/VR.

images.caption: Visualizing the automated decimation process on a complex engine block model.

name: Cottage Bakery Manager
description: A custom management tool for a home-based bakery to track orders, inventory, and automated customer messaging.
contributions: Developed the order tracking dashboard and the inventory logic to deduct ingredients automatically.
challenges: Integrating a flexible calendar system that accounts for bakery lead times.
impact: Saved the business owner an average of 10 hours per week in administrative overhead.

images.caption: The main inventory view showing low-stock alerts for critical baking ingredients.
